# pve_container (Data Source)

Reads one LXC container's configuration and runtime state. The interface list is only populated while the container is running (`GET .../interfaces` requires a running container).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_container" "ct1" {
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
}

output "ct1_status" {
  value = data.pve_container.ct1.status
}

output "ct1_mount_points" {
  value = data.pve_container.ct1.mount_points
}

# Interface addresses are only discovered while the container is running.
output "ct1_addresses" {
  value = [for iface in data.pve_container.ct1.interfaces : iface.inet]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node the container runs on.
- `vmid` (Number) Container ID (100 - 999999999).

### Read-Only

- `cores` (Number) Number of cores assigned to the container.
- `description` (String) Description of the container.
- `hostname` (String) Host name of the container.
- `id` (String) Data source identifier in the form `<node>/<vmid>`.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Network interfaces with discovered IP addresses from `GET .../interfaces`; null when the container is stopped. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `memory` (Number) RAM for the container in MB.
- `mount_points` (Attributes List) Ordered mount points including the root volume, as parsed from the config's `rootfs`/`mpN` entries. Bind mounts surface as `volume` host paths without `storage`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mount_points))
- `nameserver` (String) DNS server IP addresses of the container.
- `onboot` (Boolean) Whether the container is started during system bootup.
- `protection` (Boolean) Whether the protection flag is set.
- `searchdomain` (String) DNS search domains of the container.
- `started` (Boolean) Whether the container is currently running.
- `status` (String) Container status: `stopped` or `running`.
- `swap` (Number) SWAP for the container in MB.
- `tags` (String) Tags of the container (a `;`-separated list).
- `template` (Boolean) Whether the container is a template.
- `unprivileged` (Boolean) Whether the container runs as an unprivileged user.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `hwaddr` (String) Interface MAC address.
- `inet` (String) IPv4 address with prefix length, when assigned.
- `inet6` (String) IPv6 address with prefix length, when assigned.
- `name` (String) Interface name as seen inside the container.


<a id="nestedatt--mount_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mount_points`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (Boolean) Explicitly enable or disable ACL support.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether to include the mount point in backups (only used for volume mount points).
- `id` (String) Mount point config key: `rootfs` or `mp0`..`mp255`.
- `mountpoint` (String) Path inside the container where the volume is mounted. Required for `mpN` entries; must be empty for `rootfs` (the pin defines no `mp=` option there).
- `ro` (Boolean) Read-only mount point.
- `size` (String) Volume size in PVE disk-size notation (for example `8G`). Growth-only: shrinking is rejected and the growth is applied via the resize verb. Required when allocating a new volume from `storage`.
- `storage` (String) Storage holding the volume. Set together with `size` to allocate a new volume, or with `volume` to reference an existing one. Leave unset for bind mounts given via `volume`.
- `volume` (String) Existing volume id or host path (bind mount). Takes precedence over storage allocation when `storage` is unset.
